text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 2: CAMS beats ERA5 by 3.7 to 4.1 points on every row set'

g.text: Figure 2: CAMS beats ERA5 by 3.7 to 4.1 points on every row set

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top panel of each block: each product's mean absolute error minus ERA5's. Lower panel: that row set's planned contrasts, the first product's error minus the second's. Compare products only within a block: each block is scored on its own rows, so an error in one block is not comparable with an error in another. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire. The lighter, hollow row is CAMS, repeated in every block as a yardstick and contrasted with that block's own ERA5. Hollow triangle: the same contrast at the second hyperparameter setting, shown for planned contrasts and for contrasts near the 5% line. Planned: one of the comparisons written into the study plan before any result existed. Every other row is exploratory.'
